module.name: no-redundant-boolean
module.description: Simplify comparisons only when operands are syntactically boolean and preserve boolean ternary results.

scenarios.name: should allow strict boolean comparisons of unknown-valued operands
scenarios.given: value === true where value may be a number
scenarios.then: no violation or autofix is produced

scenarios.name: should simplify a syntactically boolean comparison
scenarios.then: a redundantBoolean violation is reported with a fix to value > 0

scenarios.name: should coerce a truthy ternary condition to a boolean
scenarios.given: condition ? true : false where condition may be nonboolean
scenarios.then: a redundantBoolean violation is reported with a fix to !!condition

scenarios.name: should negate a truthy ternary condition
scenarios.then: a redundantBoolean violation is reported with a fix to !condition

scenarios.name: should remove double negation from a boolean comparison
scenarios.then: a redundantBoolean violation is reported with a parenthesized fix that preserves operator precedence

scenarios.name: should preserve arithmetic and typeof precedence
scenarios.when: the rule fixes the double negation
scenarios.then: the comparison remains parenthesized in the replacement

scenarios.name: should preserve comments inside fix candidates
scenarios.given: a redundant comparison, ternary, or double negation contains a comment
scenarios.then: no violation or autofix removes the comment
